title: When Shah Rukh Khan Credited Salim Khan For Making Him The 'King' He Is Today | Bollywood News - News18
text: If Shah Rukh Khan is who he is today, renowned worldwide for his charismatic screen presence and impressive acting skills, it is all because of one person. None other than the legendary screenwriter and Salman Khan’s father, Salim Khan . The Bollywood superstar once recalled that the generosity and support of the Khan family in the early days were pivotal in shaping his journey to stardom. After the 90-year-old screenwriter was admitted to Lilavati Hospital in Bandra, Mumbai, following a health deterioration, SRK’s old interview, in which he talked about his bond with Salim Khan, resurfaced. While speaking with IANS in 2018, the Pathaan actor shared, “I am Shah Rukh Khan today because of Salim Khan." Shah Rukh Khan Recalled How Salim Khan Helped Him Out Shah Rukh further revealed that Salim Khan had opened the door to his home for him when he was struggling in the industry. “The first time I came to Mumbai as a struggling actor, I had my meals at Salman Khan’s place, where Salim Khan ji supported me a lot. It is because of them I have become ‘Shah Rukh Khan’," he explained. FYI, SRK made his debut in the entertainment industry in the late 1980s. Initially, he appeared in television shows before venturing into films with the 1992 musical romance Deewana. When Sooraj Pancholi Recalled Salim Khan’s Generosity Not just to Shah Rukh, Salim Khan and his family extended their warmth and support to many other celebrities. They are known for helping out anyone who needs guidance or food. Once in an interview with Instant Bollywood, actor Sooraj Pancholi revealed that their home at Galaxy Apartments would remain open at all times. “Their Galaxy house was always open. Anyone who wanted to come could come. No lock, always open. You could just push it anytime and walk right in. Whenever you want. You could open their fridge and eat whatever you want," he shared. Salim Khan Is Receiving Treatment At Hospital Salim Khan was rushed to the hospital in Mumbai recently. A doctor treating the veteran screenwriter has confirmed that he suffered a minor brain haemorrhage. He is now on a ventilator support. Previously, it was said that Salman Khan’s father was diagnosed with a blood clot and was feeling ‘very giddy’ when he rushed to the hospital. Later on February 18 morning, a report by News24 claimed that Salim Khan’s blood pressure spiked recently, which caused internal bleeding on the right side of his brain. The entire Khan family is at Lilavati Hospital with him. His son, superstar Salman Khan, was seen at the hospital. Besides Salman, both of Salim Khan’s wives, Salma and Helen, were also at the hospital.
